name: Meclonazepam
metabolism: Evidence is from a peer-reviewed review of designer benzodiazepines (Edinoff et al., Neurol Int 2022, PMID 35997362). A study investigating meclonazepam metabolism in both in vitro and in vivo trials identified two major metabolites suitable as biomarkers: amino-meclonazepam and acetamido-meclonazepam.
summary: Meclonazepam is a benzodiazepine derivative structurally similar to clonazepam. It was never used as a medicine and has appeared online as a designer drug.
